title: 归航109

music_prompt.caption_en: A pop-rock ballad with a warm, weathered male vocal reminiscent of the Eagles' lead singer. The arrangement starts with a solo classical guitar arpeggio in a minor key, evoking nostalgia and the sea. As the chorus hits, the key shifts to major, drums and bass enter with a steady 4/4 beat, and the guitar becomes more strummed and driving. A Scottish bagpipe melody weaves through the bridge, adding a touch of wanderlust and pride. African djembe provides a subtle, earthy rhythm beneath the chorus. The outro returns to solo classical guitar in minor, fading with a sense of quiet pride. No electronic elements; all acoustic instruments. The vocal delivery is gritty, nasal, and unpolished, like a sailor telling his story over a campfire.
music_prompt.chord_progression: Verse: Em - C - G - D | Chorus: G - D - Em - C | Bridge: Am - C - D - G (with bagpipes)
instruments: drum kit (brushes on snare, kick on 1 & 3)
music_prompt.mood: nostalgic, proud, warm, gritty, reflective, uplifting
music_prompt.vocal_style: Warm, gritty, nasal male vocal with a natural, unpolished delivery. Slight vibrato on held notes. Phrasing is loose and conversational, like a storyteller. Inspired by Don Henley's tone but with more nasal resonance and a touch of rasp. The singer should sound like a seasoned sailor, not a polished pop star.
music_prompt.special_notes: Vocal style adapted from '二虎' reference: Eagles-like warm, gritty, nasal male voice. Scottish bagpipes and African djembe added per '二虎' preferences, but used sparingly to maintain pop-rock foundation. No electronic elements. Key modulation from Em to G for chorus to evoke pride, then back to Em for outro.

不再是当年那支 只有木船的舰队
每一片浪花里 都藏着钢铁的誓言
